testcase.name: Scenario: Restore a hidden panel in the undocked ribbon: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-visibility-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:109:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Restore a hidden panel in the undocked ribbon ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active ✔ And the 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top with Modify visible ✔ When the user hides Modify through Show Panels ✔ And the user undocks the ribbon ✔ Then the floating ribbon does not show the Modify group ✔ When the user opens Show Panels on the floating ribbon ✔ Then Modify is unchecked ✔ When the user selects Modify ✔ Then the Modify group appears between Create and Explore in the floating ribbon ✔ When the user docks the floating ribbon at the left ✔ Then the Modify group is visible in the side-docked ribbon
